discovery_notes: Wave 2 WDW 2025-2026 LE slice; 28 WebSearch calls, all search_snippet. Mostly WDWNT Pin Tuesday posts, second source Disney Pins Blog where cheap. Conflicts kept: AK Muppets mini jumbo (WDWNT 'Animal' vs DPB 'Tree of Life'; DPB adds Expedition Everest pin), Kate & Maria box set 2,500 vs Disney Store 2,400. Inkwells of Evil DPB list repeats Captain Hook; a Pinventory listing reportedly names Gaston/Wicked Witch (not recorded). Pirates mystery set (Apr 2025) may be WDI. Skipped: Fantasia 85th jumbo (no size), Doctor's Day, Enchanted Ensemble mystery, Disneyland-only items, 55th Mickey & Minnie LE 5,000 (unattributable). June 23 2026 WDWNT URL had an email tracking query string; recorded without it. No instruction-like content seen.
